study_identification_part.si_4_title: Probing individual-level structural atrophy in frontal glioma patients

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Single-site cohort scanned at Beijing Tiantan Hospital (glioma patients and healthy controls).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "All subjects were scanned with a Philips Ingenia 3.0 T MRI scanner at Beijing Tiantan Hospital."

answer.SINGLE-SITE: healthy controls for normative model; glioma patients for individual abnormality analysis

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Healthy controls build normative GM/WM volume models; patient data used to generate SAMs and compute abnormality indexes.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "A final cohort of 45 patients ... and 51 age-matched healthy controls ... were included in the study." "First, a normative brain volume model was constructed using the healthy controls' data." "Then, for each glioma patient, an individual SAM was generated..."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Zhang2022.pdf.md: Subjects; Generation of individual structural abnormality map

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Healthy controls used to construct separate GM and WM normative models; training split not reported.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "A final cohort of 45 patients ... and 51 age-matched healthy controls ... were included in the study." "Using this approach, the normative GM and WM volume models were separately constructed."
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Zhang2022.pdf.md: Subjects; Generation of individual structural abnormality map

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Healthy control age reported as mean ± SD years for the control cohort; same values used for both GM and WM normative models.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Control sex counts reported as M/F; percentages computed from 51 controls for both GM and WM normative models.
